scope: Field-DCT gate hardware acceptance; raw captures remain local.
previously_rejected: phase1_supported required frame_pred_frame_dct, so this stream was refused before decode by the released bitstream.

reference_decode_comparison.method: Final hardware raster against ffmpeg's decode of the same file, BT.601 limited-range luma expanded to full range.
reference_decode_comparison.exclusions: Telemetry overlay including its one-column left edge, and image column zero.
reference_decode_comparison.interpretation: Field-DCT reconstruction is correct. A decoder ignoring dct_type would scramble the macroblocks that used it; the non-contiguous woven bar rows reproduce exactly and no pixel differs by more than one unit of rounding.

column_zero_difference.description: Image column zero is black in hardware where the reference is bright, on the eight bar rows; column one onward matches.
column_zero_difference.evidence: Entries 645 and 646, captured on the released bitstream with the same bar content, show identical column-zero blanking.

regression_outstanding: The seven existing fixtures have not been replayed on this bitstream. The writer's capture-counter and untruncated-origin changes affect frame-DCT blocks too.
gate_scope_caveat: Field DCT decodes; this does not make commercial discs play. Interlaced P and B remain the gate that does.
separate_unresolved_issues: Logic fell 372 ALMs and 912 registers while adding a feature; unexplained.
Setup slack fell 0.117 ns to +0.126 ns on the HDMI domain.
